{{Quote|How dare such an unbeliever make statements that completely invalidate our faith. In taking out a contract on Javin, the Fellowship of Kooroo has declared holy war against this infidel. Although our beliefs prohibit us from partaking in acts of violence, they do not forbid us from encouraging others to engage in such acts, especially when they are in the greater interest of the Fellowship.|Massus Gyne|<ref name="GNN13" />}}
'''Massus Gyne''' was a [[High Reverend]] of the [[Fellowship of Kooroo]].<ref name="GNN13" /> In [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="2 ABY">{{JournalCite|13|Galaxywide NewsNets}} &mdash; [[Sektor 242 NewsLine]] transmitted [[NewsNet]] report from [[Port Fyrin]] on [[Qalydon/Legends|Qalydon]] on the date 38:2:9, which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], per the reasoning [[Template:YearMathGRS|here]].</ref> Gyne issued a bounty for [[Andor Javin]], a [[TriNebulon News/Legends|TriNebulon News]] [[Journalist/Legends|journalist]] after Javin made claims disparaging the Fellowship and their beliefs. On the [[Great ReSynchronization|date]] 38:2:9, the [[Sektor 242 NewsLine]] transmitted a report from [[Port Fyrin]] on [[Qalydon/Legends|Qalydon]]. An interview with Massus Gyne was included in the report.<ref name="GNN13" />
